Frequently asked questions

Is WoG Index official?

No. WoG Index is an independent, unofficial fan database for War of Genesis: Idle Loot, a game by ANTIGO. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the developer.

Where does the data come from?

Data is extracted directly from the game's own tables (msgpack .bin files). Names are resolved via the bundled locale files so they match what you see in game.

Is it free?

Yes. Every section — heroes, gear, items, monsters, stages, gacha and drop tables — is completely free, with no login required.
